source: The owner's starter decks, checked against Scryfall on 2026-10-20.

decks.title: Skyward Patrol
decks.description: Build a flock of flyers, keep cards flowing, and let Kangee turn small evasive creatures into a coordinated air force.
decks.how_to_play: Develop mana and two or three flyers. Let Kangee survive a turn, then attack with the flock to trigger its bonus. Save an answer for the opposing swing turn.
decks.teaches: Flying, vigilance, attack triggers and holding up instant-speed answers.

decks.title: Graveyard Shift
decks.description: A resilient Zombie army that uses its graveyard as a second hand. Gisa and Geralf let you recast one Zombie during each of your turns.
decks.how_to_play: Cast cheap Zombies, fill your graveyard naturally, then replay useful Zombies through your commander. Win by attacking with a growing army and recurring fallen creatures.
decks.teaches: Self-mill, graveyard casting and creature-type bonuses. Recasting a Zombie still costs its normal mana.

decks.title: Ember Rebellion
decks.description: Attack with an expendable army. Garna rewards fallen attackers with cards and other creature deaths with damage to each opponent.
decks.how_to_play: Build a steady stream of creatures and tokens. With Garna present, sacrifice attacking creatures before combat ends when useful to draw cards. Rebuild after trades.
decks.teaches: Combat trades, death triggers and paying a sacrifice cost. This is a combat deck with sacrifice support.

decks.title: Wild Stampede
decks.description: A straightforward creature deck: develop extra mana, cast large trampling creatures, and attack together for Targ Nar's pack tactics bonus.
decks.how_to_play: Keep an opener with green mana and a ramp spell. Build toward a six-power attack, then use trample and a carefully timed pump spell to finish.
decks.teaches: Ramp, trample, pack tactics and combat tricks. Avoid spending every card into a possible board wipe.

decks.title: United Front
decks.description: Create a wide army of creature tokens and turn small bodies into a winning attack. Emmara supplies a lifelink Soldier whenever she becomes tapped.
decks.how_to_play: Use convoke or safe attacks to tap Emmara. Save an army-wide pump spell for a decisive attack, and protect your tokens when a sweeper appears.
decks.teaches: Tokens, convoke and team-wide bonuses. Convoke can tap a creature even on the turn it enters.

decks.title: Life and Legacy
decks.description: Gain small amounts of life as creatures arrive, then drain opponents when your creatures die. The deck wins through steady attacks and attrition.
decks.how_to_play: Play creatures that leave a replacement behind. Trade in combat or use a sacrifice effect for value, then recover creatures from the graveyard.
decks.teaches: Lifelink, enter-the-battlefield and death triggers. Life gain helps survival; it is not the only win condition.

decks.title: Spellfire Squadron
decks.description: Deploy a team of small creatures, then cast inexpensive spells before combat. Balmor gives the whole team extra power and trample with each instant or sorcery.
decks.how_to_play: Start with two or three creatures, keep a draw spell ready, and combine spells with an attack. Token makers give Balmor more creatures to enhance.
decks.teaches: Prowess-style triggers, cantrips and spell timing. Most pump effects expire at the end of the turn.

decks.title: Saproling Swarm
decks.description: Grow a Saproling army and make opponents pay when it dies. Slimefoot creates more tokens and turns their deaths into damage and life gain.
decks.how_to_play: Make Saprolings, keep Slimefoot safe, and attack or sacrifice tokens when it earns value. Use team bonuses to finish rather than waiting for a combo.
decks.teaches: Token production, death triggers and resource management. Spore counters take time to grow into tokens.

decks.title: Forged in Battle
decks.description: Arm a small band of warriors with reusable Equipment. Bruenor boosts equipped creatures and makes your first equip activation each turn cost zero.
decks.how_to_play: Play creatures before loading up on Equipment. Spread Equipment when possible, then use the free equip to move a key weapon before attacking.
decks.teaches: Equipment, equip timing and commander damage. Equipment stays on the battlefield when its creature dies.

decks.title: Tides of Growth
decks.description: Turn ordinary land drops into cards and life, then use the extra resources to cast large creatures. Landfall creatures reward the same simple plan.
decks.how_to_play: Develop green mana and ramp first. Cast Tatyova when you can follow with a land, then use your cards to build a board of sizeable creatures.
decks.teaches: Landfall, sequencing land drops and balancing development with answers. Tatyova is valuable but the creatures can win without her.
